tool_args.rationale: The observed coupled-transient signature supports the guided two-state memory mechanism, but its five parameters need additional trajectory observations. The available fine trajectory batch addresses that identifiability gap.

The pilot includes gradients above the stated smooth-regime limit, but this probe is not in the available menu; the high-gradient branch therefore remains uncertain.
It does not resolve the identified mechanism ambiguity.
